column3: Close to the Hebrew; “instruction” (torah) is rendered “the law.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he will decide for” is rendered “rebuke.”
Close to the Hebrew; “those whom I have harmed” is rendered “those whom I have afflicted.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the one far removed” is rendered “the outcast.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Migdal Eder” is rendered “tower of the flock,” and “the hill (Ophel)” “The stronghold.”
Close to the Hebrew; “shout a shout” is rendered “cry aloud.”
Close to the Hebrew; “burst forth” is rendered “labor to bring forth,” and “the open country” “the field.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will devote … their unjust gain” is rendered “I will consecrate their gain.”
